Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision

Class VisionConstants

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision.VisionConstants
public class VisionConstants extends Object
Configuration for a Vision instance: which cameras to create, where they are mounted, how to obtain the AprilTag field layout, and how to read the robot's current pose. Built with a fluent withX(...) API and passed to Vision(VisionConstants).

Vision(VisionConstants) treats a config with no cameras, no fieldLayoutGetter, or no robotPoseSupplier as incomplete and disables vision entirely, so all three must be set for vision to function.

    • withLimelight

      public VisionConstants withLimelight(String name)
      Registers a Limelight camera. Limelight cameras compute their own pose estimate on-device, so no mounting transform is needed here.
      Parameters:
      name - the Limelight's configured network name, used to look it up over NetworkTables
      Returns:
      this, for chaining
